name: Smart Provider Fallback
description: Tracks provider failure rates and auto-switches to a fallback provider when failure rate exceeds threshold.

ringBufferSize.description: Number of recent calls to track for failure rate (default: 10)

failureRateThreshold.description: Failure rate (0-1) above which to switch providers (default: 0.4)

fallbackProvider.description: Provider ID to use when primary fails

fallbackModel.description: Model ID to use with fallback provider

recoverySuccessCount.description: Successful calls needed to restore primary provider (default: 3)
